message.content: I check the tickets at the entrance, make sure the snack shelves are full, and sweep the lobby. I usually start at eight in the morning, take the tram, and get to work. The voice I sometimes hear doesn’t really bother me much when I’m busy. It’s just there sometimes, like a distant noise. I don’t know what it means, but I’ve learned to ignore it most of the time. My sister says I should get help, but I don’t think it’s that bad. I’ve been doing this job for a while now, and it’s been okay.
